title: [main] Bug 653921 Warehouse pick fails with "Nothing to handle" when an earlier unshipped pick uses a non-default shipment bin
summary: Warehouse pick validation now correctly recognizes picked quantities in non-default shipment bins at basic warehouse locations, preventing false "Nothing to handle" failures when an earlier pick remains unshipped.
key_points: CalcQtyOnShipmentBins fallback logic added to find picked stock in non-default shipment bins
Addresses issue where picked quantities were incorrectly reset to zero, blocking subsequent picks
Uses existing CalcQtyOnBin helper to check non-default shipment bins while preserving item-tracking filters
Fix applies to basic warehouse locations where shipment bins lack explicit Ship bin type
